name: branding-indigo-squiggle-logo-on-icon-construction-grid-with-photo-cards
title: Indigo Squiggle Icon on Construction Grid
whatItIs: A lavender page with a large white app-icon tile holding an indigo looping squiggle mark on a faint construction grid of circles and diagonals, a dashed line hanging from the top, a Logo pill, two rounded photo cards of older adults labelled Still Active and Feeling Secure, and a priorities sentence.
whatItMeans: Showing the icon's grid proves craft, and warm photo cards give the mark human meaning.
techniques: Icon on a construction grid overlay
Dashed line hanging into the composition
Italic sentence with dark and light phrases

vocabulary.definition: Grid lines and circles showing how an icon was built.
A rounded square holding a logo for a home screen.
A label naming an emotion a photo represents.
